messages.subject: Trouble creating umf for stacked data
parts:
Hi,
I have 3 years of occupancy data from 45 sites. Each of these sites have been surveyed for 7 consecutive nights, 4 times a year, so I have a maximum of 84 observations. Originally I wanted to do a multiple season analysis but it has been suggested on this forum to stack the years of data and do a single season analysis. I have been trying to get my data in to an unmarked data frame, but as many others have mentioned, the csvToUMF function is converting all of my continuous variables to factors. While I have tried the various suggestions such as using "read.csv", removing the site covariates and adding them after the umf is created separately, and joining the y, siteCovs, and obsCovs .csv files, I have not found a solution to what is causing the issue. I believe my data (which has several obscovs) is in long format and while I won't be using every single covariate in the analysis, I'd like to bring everything in to R at once. What steps am I missing? I haven't found any other posts with solutions. I am attaching the .csv files and R file here. Any help is appreciated.
Cheers,
Rachel
